G0.threshold: Motor VM physically disconnected; motor locked; operator confirms safe fixture
G0.observed: Operator reported motor VM connected and powered. No firmware was uploaded.

G1.threshold: HELLO; >=95% IRF/IRB/IRH expected coverage; scan rate measured; six channels; malformed/drop/DMA/timeout/overrun/failure deltas zero
G1.observed: Local software checks pass; no MCU data, HELLO, scan rate, or counters collected.

G2.threshold: Three independent 20-second trials per in-range channel/distance with geometry and environment metadata

G3.threshold: SNR >= 5 and >=25% STD reduction at most tested distances without loss of wall variation
G3.observed: No physical wall/no-wall data; no filter ranking.

G4.threshold: At least 10 rising and falling events per region; latency at adequate resolution; v_target * latency <= 5 mm
G4.observed: No event data; existing exported IRF is 40 Hz and cannot resolve a 5 ms budget.

G5.threshold: Measured false-positive/negative and cross-talk across light/material/angle/position with no safety-relevant misclassification

G6.threshold: Per-channel monotonic LUT; independent holdout MAE <= 2 mm and P95 absolute error <= 5 mm; no extrapolation

filter_decision: No filter selected; keep all candidates experimental and production IR_GetLatest behavior unchanged.
retry_blocker: Physically disconnect motor VM, then reconfirm safety before upload and P0 capture.
